messages.content:
You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (39.9 s) ===
[0.0-1.4] ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Protective): "Stay back. I'll open it."
[1.2-3.0] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.
[1.9-7.6] SCREEN: Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.
[2.7-7.5] PEASANT MOTHER (Frantic, Weeping): "Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!"
[7.6-9.9] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.
[7.8-9.7] JULIANA (Urgent, Compassionate): "Bring him here. Quickly."
[8.4-10.6] ACTION: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
[10.2-11.6] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.
[11.6-14.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.
[11.9-16.2] JULIANA (Reassuring, Focused): "He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?"
[14.2-16.4] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
[16.4-20.4] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.
[16.9-20.3] PEASANT MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious): "Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset."
[20.4-23.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
[23.6-25.2] ACTION: Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
[25.2-27.4] SCREEN: Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.
[25.4-27.2] JULIANA (Muttering, Intent): "Feverfew... Not alone."
[27.4-30.4] SCREEN: Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.
[28.2-30.2] JULIANA (Determined): "Chamomile... and willow bark."
[30.4-32.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.
[31.3-32.2] ALEXANDER (Grave): "You're certain?"
[32.4-34.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.
[32.7-33.8] JULIANA (Resolute): "I have to be."
[34.4-36.2] ACTION: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.
[34.6-36.2] JULIANA (Urgent): "Alexander, I need hot water."
[36.3-37.2] ALEXANDER (Prompt): "I'm on it."
[37.2-38.9] ACTION: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.
[37.4-38.9] PEASANT MOTHER (Sobbing): "Please save him."
[38.6-39.9] ACTION: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.

=== CLIP B (40.8 s) ===
[0.0-3.6] PEASANT MOTHER (Reverent, Vowing): "I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."
[3.3-4.3] ACTION: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
[3.6-6.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.
[3.9-6.3] ALEXANDER (Stern, Warning): "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
[6.3-8.3] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.
[6.4-8.2] JULIANA (Defiant, Principled): "A child's life matters more than gossip."
[8.3-10.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.
[8.4-10.4] ALEXANDER (Dark, Cautionary): "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."
[10.5-12.6] SCREEN: Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.
[10.8-12.6] JULIANA (Committed, Unshakable): "Then we will face it together."
[12.6-15.3] SCREEN: Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
[12.8-15.3] ACTION: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
[15.3-16.8] SCREEN: Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.
[15.4-16.2] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Aloof, Without Looking Up): "What is it?"
[16.8-19.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.
[16.8-19.1] THE FORMER GROOM (Hesitant, Deferential): "There is a rumor going around, my Lord."
[19.0-20.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.
[19.4-20.2] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Coldly Curious): "What rumor?"
[20.8-23.8] SCREEN: Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.
[20.9-23.9] THE FORMER GROOM (Uneasy): "About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."
[23.8-26.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.
[24.1-26.1] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Arrogant): "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."
[26.0-29.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.
[26.3-30.0] THE FORMER GROOM (Tense, Solemn): "The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."
[29.8-31.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.
[30.2-30.7] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sharp, Demanding): "Where?"
[31.0-32.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.
[31.1-32.4] THE FORMER GROOM (Cautious): "No one seems certain."
[32.8-34.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.
[33.0-34.7] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive, Masking Panic): "Then let it remain a rumor."
[34.8-36.8] SCREEN: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
[36.8-40.8] SCREEN: Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.
[38.6-40.0] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Shaken): "Impossible."
